name: vscode-md-html-preview
description: Live HTML preview tuned for PDF/docling paper Markdown: KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, image embedding, foldable references, docling tables, and A4 print CSS. Mirrors the standalone HTML produced by tools/pdf_to_html.py.

mdHtmlPreview.embedImages.markdownDescription: Embed local images as base64 data URIs in the live preview. When `false` (recommended for live editing) images are loaded via Webview resource URIs, which keeps refreshes fast. Standalone export always embeds images regardless of this setting.

mdHtmlPreview.openReferences.markdownDescription: Open the `참고문헌` (References) `<details>` section by default. Turn off to collapse references for on-screen reading; export keeps them open so they are not omitted in print.

mdHtmlPreview.removeTopImages.markdownDescription: Remove the first N images (typically publisher logos / decorative header images extracted by docling). Scientific figures after the first N are kept.

mdHtmlPreview.plainCitations.markdownDescription: Render citation markers like `[13]`, `[81, 82]` and other `[text](url)` links as plain text (no `<a>` tags), matching the paper HTML pipeline. Turn off to keep Markdown links as clickable anchors.

mdHtmlPreview.debounceMs.markdownDescription: Debounce delay (ms) between an edit and the preview refresh.

mdHtmlPreview.scrollSync.markdownDescription: Synchronize scroll position between the Markdown editor and the HTML preview in both directions.
